submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. One NEW independently drawn NE run animation frame 3/16 for the same Mountain Guardian Boy. Edit image1 as SAME CAMERA / fixed full canvas scale / body proportions / head size / staff dimensions, adjusting only the articulated gait. Image2 approved character identity, image3NE idle orientation, image4PRIMARY clean bright rounded rich hand-painted Daoist style. NORTH-EAST REAR THREE-QUARTER CAMERA running away to upper RIGHT exactly as image1 and image3. Back of head/robe dominates, right cheek edge only, NO full eye or frontal face. Anatomical RIGHT staff arm NEAR at screenRIGHT; LEFT shield arm FAR behind screenLEFT. Forward leg moves away to upper-right in depth, rear leg extends toward lower-left/viewer and shows sole. Do not drift to N or E camera. Opposing shoulders and elbows move along this diagonal depth axis. EXACT NEW PHASE: Right mid-support; right foot under hip and shin upright, left folded knee passes forward under torso. Body down1%; both arm swings pass near center. Preserve full length rigid staff, long lower shaft below closed grip and pointed bottom tip, the staff almost the boy body height. Gold circular head SOLID backplate with relief; only dangling JADE ring has genuine transparent hole. Do not shorten weapon to fit canvas. Same brown ponytail/green ribbons/beads/gold-jade armor/ivory pants/brown boots. Root stays fixed with prescribed body bob, not lowest-foot alignment or independent fit. Knees/ankles and feet separate with physically correct near/far occlusion. Preserve exact camera and head/body scale of image1. Single native square 1024+ RGBA transparent, no mirror, grid, text, shadow, particles, duplicated limbs, pose copy or warp.
